rubrics.justification: Accurately identifies an expanded blastocyst with thin zona, prominent compact ICM, and cohesive TE consistent with 3AA; minor overinterpretation from a limited single image.
Integrates age, ovarian reserve, tubal factor, sperm quality, endometrium, prior IVF outcome, and embryo grade well; slightly overemphasizes speculative PCOS/protocol explanations.
Overall logical and structured, but includes speculative and somewhat contradictory discussion about AMH-response mismatch, possible typo, and future response expectations.

Generally consistent with Gardner grading, single high-quality day-5 transfer practice, and cautious stance on PGT-A at age 33 with one embryo; some speculative protocol comments are less guideline-based.

Provides clear next steps to proceed with transfer, counsel regarding single embryo availability, and review stimulation strategy if unsuccessful; recommendations are useful though not highly specific on protocol modifications.
